title: Top heating element fault
shortDescription: Top quartz element open or shorted.
fullDescription:
E01 on Breville Smart Oven Pro and Smart Oven Air Fryer indicates the top heating element is not drawing the expected current. Element broken or relay failed.

Verify with multimeter; replace element if open.
affectedModels: Breville Smart Oven Air Fryer BOV900

title: Bottom heating element fault
fullDescription: E02 indicates bottom element fault. Same diagnosis as E01 but on bottom element.
affectedModels: Breville Smart Oven Air Fryer BOV900
videoSearchQuery: Breville Smart Oven E02 bottom element

title: Convection fan fault
fullDescription: E03 indicates the convection fan is not turning. On Air Fryer this fan is critical for air-fry function.

fixSteps.title: Inspect fan
fixSteps.instruction: Power off, manually rotate fan blade.

affectedModels: Breville Smart Oven Air Fryer BOV900

title: Temperature sensor fault
shortDescription: Cavity NTC reading out of range.
fullDescription: E04 indicates the cavity temperature sensor is open, shorted, or disconnected.

fixSteps.title: Reseat connector
fixSteps.instruction: Open back panel, reseat sensor plug.

affectedModels: Breville Smart Oven Air Fryer BOV900

title: Over-temperature shutdown
fullDescription: E05 fires when cavity temperature exceeds safe limit, usually due to stuck relay or wrong sensor reading.

title: Door switch fault
fullDescription: E06 fires when door is closed but the door switch reports open. Failed switch or misaligned hinge.
affectedModels: Breville Smart Oven Air Fryer BOV900
videoSearchQuery: Breville Smart Oven E06 door switch

title: Display / control board fault
fullDescription: E07 indicates a control board fault. Power cycle clears transient issues; persistent fault means board replacement.

title: Cooling fan fault
fullDescription: Separate from convection fan, E08 indicates the small fan cooling the control electronics has stalled.
videoSearchQuery: Breville Smart Oven E08 cooling fan

title: Heating timeout
fullDescription: E09 fires when the oven cannot reach setpoint within timeout - failed element, low voltage, or failing relay.
affectedModels: Breville Smart Oven Air Fryer BOV900
videoSearchQuery: Breville Smart Oven E09 heating timeout

title: Communication / EEPROM fault
fullDescription: E10 indicates a communication failure between the control board and a peripheral, or EEPROM corruption.
